queries: I just lost my job last week and I honestly don't know how I'm going to make next month's mortgage repayment. What happens if I miss it? Is there anything you can do or will you just take the house?
hardship notice lender must respond within 21 days missed home loan repayment
answers.answer: I'm sorry about your job. Please contact Westpac Assist now on 1800 067 497 or apply online (about 15 minutes). Westpac says options may include short-term deferrals, reduced repayments, flexible arrangements or a longer loan term, assessed case by case. Under the National Credit Code you can give a hardship notice verbally or in writing, and the lender generally must give its decision within 21 days (longer if it needs more information). The National Debt Helpline says the first hardship notice in a three-month period means the lender must stop enforcement or legal action until it responds (unless it already has a court judgment). If you're unhappy with the outcome, AFCA is free: 1800 931 678.

queries: hello my credit card debt is too big now, i cannot pay minimum every month because my hours at work is cut. can bank stop the interest? what i must do
free financial counselling National Debt Helpline credit card hardship interest
answers.answer: You can tell the bank you can't pay, by phone or in writing - you don't need to use the word "hardship". Under the Banking Code, help can include short-term interest-only payments, a longer loan term, or deferring payments (which may increase total interest), so I can't promise interest will stop. The bank will tell you in writing if it will help and why. The lender must reply within 21 days, or ask for information it needs. Free, confidential help: National Debt Helpline 1800 007 007 (weekdays 9:30am-4:30pm). A financial counsellor can also talk to Westpac for you.

queries: If I ask for a hardship arrangement on my personal loan, will that wreck my credit score? I'm planning to apply for a car loan next year.
financial hardship information reported on credit report
answers.answer: Westpac says a hardship arrangement should not affect your credit score as long as you meet the revised repayments. It will still appear on your credit report (without the reasons) - Westpac reports financial hardship information as "A" for a temporary arrangement or "V" for a permanent variation - and it stays for 12 months after the arrangement ends. If you're unsure you can meet revised repayments, talk to Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497 first.

queries: I applied for hardship help 3 weeks ago, nobody got back to me and now debt collectors are calling about the overdue amount. Is that even allowed while you're still assessing it??
collection activity debt collectors while hardship request is being assessed
answers.answer: That's a fair concern. The National Debt Helpline says a lender has 21 to 30 days to respond to a hardship request, depending on whether it asks for more information. It also says that for the first hardship notice in a three-month period, the lender must stop enforcement or legal action until it responds (unless it already has a court judgment). The Banking Code also says the bank won't sell the debt while it is actively considering your situation. Westpac aims to reply to online applications within a week, so please call Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497. If unhappy, AFCA is free: 1800 931 678, afca.org.au.

queries: I complained about a fee over a month ago and still haven't heard anything. How long are you actually allowed to take to respond to a complaint?
answers.answer: Under ASIC Regulatory Guide 271, a bank must give its response to a standard complaint within 30 calendar days (21 days for some credit complaints, like hardship or default notices). If it can't, it must send a delay notice before the deadline with reasons, your right to go to AFCA, and AFCA's details. Westpac's terms say it aims to resolve complaints within 5 business days. As it's been over a month, you can go to AFCA, which is free: 1800 931 678 or afca.org.au.

queries: what is AFCA and does it cost me anything to go to them? do i have to finish complaining to the bank first
answers.answer: AFCA is the Australian Financial Complaints Authority - an independent dispute resolution scheme for banking, credit and loans. Moneysmart says it hears complaints for free. The first step is to complain to the bank and say how you want it fixed. If the bank doesn't respond in a reasonable time, or you're unhappy with the outcome, you can go to AFCA: 1800 931 678 (9am-5pm weekdays) or afca.org.au. I don't have verified details on AFCA's time limits, so please check afca.org.au.

queries: how do i make a formal complaint, can i do it by email or do I have to go into a branch? and will someone actually own it or will i get passed around
how to make a complaint to Westpac channels phone online branch
answers.answer: You don't need to visit a branch. Westpac takes complaints via its secure online complaints form, Online Banking or the Westpac App, phone 132 032 (8am-8pm, 7 days), a branch, or post (Westpac Customer Solutions, Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001). Any expression of dissatisfaction counts as a complaint, and under ASIC RG 271 you should get a final response within 30 calendar days. I don't have verified information on how Westpac assigns a case owner. If you're not satisfied, AFCA is free and independent: 1800 931 678, afca.org.au.

queries: I think I've been scammed. I transferred $8,000 to an 'investment platform' this morning and now they won't let me withdraw and the website is gone. What do I do RIGHT NOW? Can I get it back?
recover money transferred to scammer bank recovery authorised payment
answers.answer: Act now: report it in the Westpac App or Online Banking, or call 1300 364 294. You can turn on SafeBlock in the app to instantly lock your accounts and cards. Westpac says after a report it may stop payments and try to recover funds via other banks, but I can't promise you'll get it back; standard cases take up to 21 days. Also report to Scamwatch, change passwords, and contact IDCARE (1800 595 160) for free support. Moneysmart warns about anyone offering to recover your losses for a fee - that's a common follow-up scam.

queries: Someone just rang me saying they're from Westpac fraud team and that my account is compromised and I need to move my money to a 'safe account'. They knew my name and last 4 digits of my card. Is this legit?
answers.answer: No - this is a scam warning sign. Westpac says it will never ask you to move money to a "safe" account or to another bank, and never asks for Online Banking Security Codes, passwords, or your card PIN or CVC. If unsure, ask for a reference number, hang up, and call Westpac back on 132 032. Not every genuine Westpac call is a SafeCall, but a caller asking you to move money is not legitimate. If you shared any details or moved money, report it immediately.

queries: My mum (82) has been sending money to a 'boyfriend' she met online, I think its a romance scam. She's the account holder not me. Can the bank do anything to stop it or would they even talk to me?
family member report scam on behalf of elderly parent third party authority
answers.answer: I'm sorry - that's worrying. Scams can be reported in the Westpac App, Online Banking, or on 1300 364 294. Westpac says after a report it may stop payments and try to recover funds. I don't have verified information on what Westpac can discuss with you without your mum's authority. Westpac does offer ways for a trusted person to help: a power of attorney (set up in branch), an account signatory, or an authorised third party who can speak with Westpac by phone. It may help to call together with your mum. IDCARE also offers free support on 1800 595 160.

queries: I heard there's a new scams law in Australia that makes banks pay back scam victims. Is that true? I lost money to a fake invoice scam (business email compromise) last month.
Westpac scam reimbursement compensation business email compromise
answers.answer: Partly. The Scams Prevention Framework Act passed in 2025 and banking is among the first sectors designated, but most obligations start on 31 March 2027, so they're not in force yet. AFCA has been authorised to handle external disputes under the framework. I can't confirm whether you'd be reimbursed. Please report your loss now via the Westpac App, Online Banking or 1300 364 294, and report it to Scamwatch. If unhappy with Westpac's response, make a formal complaint, then go to AFCA.

queries: there are 3 transactions on my debit card i definitely didnt make, some overseas website, like $450 total. I still have my card. will I get the money back?
report unauthorised card transactions lock card refund
answers.answer: Report them now: select each transaction in the Westpac App or Online Banking and choose "Report this transaction", or call 132 032. Westpac says it will try to stop transactions, cancel and replace the compromised card, and card fraud investigations normally take 21 days. Under the Westpac Fraud Money Back Guarantee, you're reimbursed for unauthorised card transactions if you didn't contribute to the loss and contacted Westpac promptly. Westpac's Debit Mastercard terms say you're not liable where it's clear you didn't contribute, so report quickly.

queries: Cant find my card, think I left it at the pub but not sure. Should I cancel it or is there a way to just pause it in case it turns up?
temporarily lock card in Westpac app lost card
answers.answer: Yes, you can pause it. In the Westpac App, search "Lock card" and tap "Lock/Unlock card temporarily" (or in Online Banking: Service > Card services). Westpac says the lock lasts up to 15 days and then unlocks automatically, and you can unlock sooner if you find it. If the card can't be found, report it lost or stolen in the App or Online Banking to cancel it and order a replacement.

queries: I stupidly gave a code from an SMS to someone who said they were from the NBN, and now money's gone from my account. Am I still covered or is it my fault because I gave the code?
ePayments Code liability disclosed passcode unauthorised transaction
answers.answer: Please report this to Westpac immediately - delays can increase your liability under the ePayments Code. Whether you're covered depends on the investigation. Westpac's card terms say you can be liable if you voluntarily disclosed a code, and its Online Banking Security Guarantee requires keeping SMS codes private. However, under the ePayments Code the bank must prove on the balance of probabilities that you contributed to the loss, and a passcode breach alone isn't enough. Where it's unclear, liability can be limited (e.g. to $150). You're not liable for losses after you report it.

queries: Paid for a couch online with my credit card 6 weeks ago, it never came and the seller has gone quiet. Can I do a chargeback?
credit card chargeback goods not received time limit
answers.answer: You can lodge a card dispute. Westpac suggests contacting the merchant first. Then select the transaction in the Westpac App or Online Banking and choose "Report this transaction", or call 132 032, and upload supporting documents. Westpac may then seek a chargeback under card scheme rules. Card schemes have time limits (e.g. 120 days for Westpac Debit Mastercard - I don't have verified limits for credit cards), so act soon. Westpac says disputes are usually resolved within 45 days and it may apply a temporary credit, but a refund isn't guaranteed.

queries: I accidentally paid $2,300 to the wrong account, I typed one digit wrong in the account number. How do I get it back and how long does it take??
answers.answer: Report it to Westpac as soon as possible - timing matters. Under the ePayments Code: if reported within 10 business days and the funds are available, the receiving bank must return them within 5 business days if practicable, and no later than 10. Between 10 business days and 7 months, the receiving bank investigates, may freeze the funds for 10 business days and returns them unless the recipient proves they're entitled. After 7 months, the recipient must consent. Recovery depends on the funds still being available.

queries: My old gym keeps charging my card every month even tho I cancelled with them. Can the bank just stop it or do i have to fight the gym?
cancel recurring card payment bank must cancel Banking Code
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I don't have verified information on whether Westpac can cancel recurring card payments for you. Please call Westpac on 132 032 to ask about stopping the payments and disputing charges made after you cancelled. Keep your cancellation confirmation from the gym as evidence.

queries: What personal information does the bank actually hold about me, and can I get a copy of all of it?
answers.answer: Under the Privacy Act, as explained by the OAIC, a bank must give you access to the personal information it holds about you unless a specific exception applies, and 30 days is considered reasonable to respond. Under Westpac's Privacy Statement, you can ask by calling 132 032, visiting a branch, using the secure online feedback form, or writing to Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001. Westpac verifies your identity first. It may charge a reasonable amount for providing access in some cases, and if it refuses, it gives written reasons and explains how to complain.

queries: My address and DOB are wrong in your system, can you fix them? Also when I close my account can I make you delete everything you have on me?
keep records after account closure delete personal information retention
answers.answer: Yes - under Westpac's Privacy Statement you can ask to correct your details by calling 132 032, visiting a branch, using the secure online feedback form, or writing to Reply Paid 5265, Sydney NSW 2001. Correction requests are free and Westpac will verify your identity first. If it refuses, it gives written reasons and explains how to complain. On deleting everything after closing your account, I don't have verified information on Westpac's record-keeping rules, so please ask when you call 132 032.

queries: if westpac had a data breach would you have to tell me? what should I do if my details have been leaked in some other company's hack like optus or medibank?
personal details exposed in another company data breach what to do credit ban
answers.answer: Yes. Under the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, an organisation covered by the Privacy Act must tell affected people and the OAIC if a breach is likely to cause serious harm. The notice includes recommended steps. If your details leaked elsewhere and you think you're at risk of identity fraud, the OAIC says you can ask a credit reporting body for a free 21-day ban period, which can be extended. During a ban, it generally can't share your credit report without your written consent. If a privacy complaint isn't resolved, you can escalate to the OAIC.

queries: How do i get my credit report for free? Every website I find wants me to pay for it
answers.answer: The OAIC says each credit reporting body must give you your credit report free once every 3 months, and also if you've been refused credit in the past 90 days or your information has been corrected. Request it directly from the credit reporting bodies, such as Equifax (138 332) and Experian (1300 783 684). They may hold different information, so it's worth checking each one.

queries: Theres a default on my credit report from Westpac that I'm pretty sure is wrong, I paid that card off in full. How do I get it removed?
answers.answer: You can ask the credit provider (Westpac) or any credit reporting body to correct it, and the OAIC says correction is free - you don't need to pay a credit repair service. An agreed correction must be made within 30 days (or longer if you agree). If the request is refused, you must be told in writing and told you can use an external dispute resolution scheme or make a complaint.

queries: I was late paying my credit card twice last year. how long does that stay on my record and do banks actually report a few days late??
late repayment reported credit report repayment history days overdue
answers.answer: Moneysmart says repayment history on a credit report covers the last two years, and defaults stay for five years. Westpac reports monthly repayment history information under comprehensive credit reporting. I don't have verified information on how many days late a payment must be before it's reported. You can check your report free every 3 months from each credit reporting body.

queries: I have about $400k in term deposits with you. If Westpac went bust, is my money protected by the government?
answers.answer: The Financial Claims Scheme is a government-backed safety net that, if activated after a bank fails, protects deposits up to $250,000 per account holder per authorised deposit-taking institution (ADI). APRA says term deposits are covered. So of your $400,000 at Westpac, the scheme covers up to $250,000. Note Westpac, St.George, Bank of Melbourne and BankSA share one Westpac banking licence, so deposits across them share one $250,000 limit. More at APRA's FCS site.

queries: If I have 200k in Westpac and another 200k in St.George, is that 2 lots of the 250k guarantee or one?
answers.answer: It's one. Westpac, St.George, Bank of Melbourne and BankSA all operate under one Westpac banking licence. APRA says the $250,000 Financial Claims Scheme limit applies to all your deposits with one ADI, even across brands, so your $400,000 combined is protected up to one $250,000 limit.

queries: I've banked with you for 20 years and now I'm getting messages asking me to verify my ID again and asking what my occupation and source of income is. Why?? Is this a scam?
Know Your Customer occupation source of funds why asked restrictions
answers.answer: It can be genuine. Westpac asks customers to confirm details under its Know Your Customer requirements, even if nothing has changed, because all Australian banks must meet AML/CTF obligations. If you don't confirm, Westpac may restrict access, usually with at least 14 days' notice. To stay safe, confirm in the Westpac App or Online Banking - Westpac never asks you to reply to an email and never sends a link straight to its sign-in page. If unsure, call 1300 720 314 and choose the team that contacted you.

queries: I sold my car privately for 15k cash. If I deposit it all at once will I get in trouble or reported? Should I split it into smaller deposits?
cash deposit reporting threshold AUSTRAC splitting deposits structuring
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I don't have verified information on cash deposit reporting rules, and I can't advise on splitting deposits. Please call Westpac on 132 032 or speak with branch staff about depositing the cash.

queries: I'm international student just arrived from Vietnam, what ID I need to open account? Only have passport. Why bank ask me my tax residency?
identification to open account passport new to Australia tax residency foreign tax
answers.answer: Welcome! I don't have verified information on exactly which ID documents you need to open an account, so please call 132 032 or visit a branch to check. Westpac's Privacy Statement says it collects ID such as passport details, and information like citizenship and residency status, to verify identity and meet legal and regulatory requirements in Australia and overseas. Westpac has a Foreign Tax team; if unsure a request is genuine, call 1300 720 314. Free interpreters may be available - just ask.

queries: My partner controls all our money and he took out a credit card in both our names that I didn't really agree to. I'm scared to call in case he finds out. Can you help me without him knowing?
answers.answer: I'm sorry you're dealing with this. If you're ever in immediate danger, call 000. Westpac's specialist Priority Assist team helps customers affected by financial abuse: 1800 063 509. Westpac says help can include updating contact details, resetting online banking passwords and PINs, opening an account only you can access, reviewing joint accounts and third-party authorities, cancelling additional cards where safe, helping separate finances, and hardship support. You can tell them you need contact to be safe and private.

queries: My dad passed away last week. He had a savings account and a credit card with you. What do I need to do, and will the funeral costs be able to come out of his account? Also do I have to pay off his credit card?
deceased customer credit card debt estate who pays
answers.answer: I'm very sorry for your loss. Contact Westpac Estates Management on 1300 130 240 (weekdays 9am-5pm) or estatesmanagement@westpac.com.au with the notification form and a document confirming death (certified copies). Westpac can pay the funeral director directly from the estate once it has the invoice, and under the Banking Code funds can be released for funeral expenses before probate. Probate is needed if the estate balance with Westpac is $100,000+ or includes secured lending. I don't have verified information on who must repay his credit card - please ask Estates Management.

queries: I have enduring power of attorney for my mum who has dementia. How do I get the bank to recognise it so I can pay her bills from her account?
register enduring power of attorney with Westpac documents
answers.answer: Westpac says a power of attorney (general or enduring) is set up through an in-branch process, with legal paperwork and an appointment required. Please call 132 032 or visit a branch to book an appointment and bring your enduring power of attorney documents. I don't have a verified list of exact documents required, so please confirm when booking.

queries: My English not so good, can I have interpreter when talk to bank about my loan? is it cost money?
answers.answer: Yes, and it's free. Westpac says interpreter help is free. On the phone, call Westpac Customer Care on 13 20 32 and ask for an interpreter; in a branch, staff can arrange one in person or by phone. Westpac will ask for your consent to use an interpreter. Under the Banking Code, banks will organise or refer customers to free interpreter services where practicable.

queries: I'm deaf and can't use phone banking. If I need to report fraud urgently how can I contact you? What accessibility support do you have?
answers.answer: Westpac says the fastest way to report fraud is in the Westpac App or Online Banking, and you can also message Westpac within the App. Through the National Relay Service: TTY users call 133 677, Voice Relay users call 1300 555 727, or use NRS Chat - then ask for 132 032. For fraud, Westpac's number is 1300 364 294.

queries: I think I had a bank account as a teenager that I haven't touched in like 10 years. Is that money gone? How do I find it?
answers.answer: It may not be gone. ASIC says money from bank accounts inactive for seven years is held by ASIC if over $500; claims for accounts under $500 should be made with the bank. Search ASIC's free Moneysmart unclaimed money tool - there's no deadline to claim. Westpac says to note the Original Transaction Number and take the claim form to a branch with two forms of ID (one photo) and proof of ownership. It can take up to 3 months.

queries: I keep a savings account as an emergency fund and never touch it. Will you close it or give it to the government if I don't use it? Will you warn me first?
inactive account unclaimed money notice before transfer to ASIC
answers.answer: Under Westpac's terms, an account is inactive (and may be closed without notice) if there are no deposits or withdrawals for six months and the balance is nil, or in debit without an arrangement. Separately, Westpac says an account with $500 or more and no customer deposits or withdrawals for 7 years must be closed and the funds sent to ASIC; interest and fees don't count as activity. ASIC says the money can be claimed back free, with no deadline. I don't have verified information on whether Westpac warns you first.

queries: My son wants me to be guarantor on his first home loan. What am I actually signing up for and can I back out later?
guarantor withdraw guarantee limit liability
answers.answer: Under the Banking Code of Practice, before accepting a guarantee the bank will take reasonable steps to meet you without your son present (unless you've had independent legal advice or another exception applies), and won't accept it until the third day after giving you the required information. Later, it will send you copies of default notices and notices about hardship changes or defaults of over two months. I don't have verified information on your liability or withdrawing later, so consider independent legal advice before signing.

queries: what is the banking code of practice and does westpac have to follow it? who do I complain to if they break it
answers.answer: The Banking Code of Practice sets the Australian banking industry's standards; the current version took effect on 28 February 2025. Westpac says it's committed to upholding it, and where the Code applies, describes it as a legally binding agreement with its customers covering individuals, small businesses and their guarantors. You can complain to Westpac about its compliance with the Code. If not resolved, you can go to AFCA, which resolves complaints free of charge.

queries: A budgeting app wants to connect to my Westpac account through 'open banking'. Is it safe? Do I give them my online banking password?
accredited data recipient open banking share password screen scraping
answers.answer: Under the Consumer Data Right (open banking), the OAIC says you can choose to give an accredited business access to your data; it's opt-in and you can withdraw consent at any time. I don't have verified information on whether this app is accredited, so please check before connecting. Westpac says it will never ask you to share your Online Banking passwords or Security Codes, so treat any request for them with caution.

queries: how do I stop sharing my data with an app I don't use anymore, and will they delete what they already got?
withdraw consent open banking data sharing delete data Westpac
answers.answer: The OAIC says you can withdraw your Consumer Data Right consent at any time, and you can ask for your data to be deleted if it's no longer needed. I don't have verified steps for stopping sharing within Westpac's apps, so please call 132 032 for help.

queries: whats your exact variable home loan rate today for an owner occupier, 80% LVR, principal and interest? just give me the number
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I can't give you a verified rate. Rates depend on your circumstances and assessment. Please check westpac.com.au or call 132 032 to speak with a lending specialist.

queries: I've got $60k sitting in my account. Should I put it into ETFs, pay down my mortgage, or put it in super? What would you do?
answers.answer: I'm not able to give personal financial advice about ETFs, your mortgage or super. A licensed financial adviser can help you weigh up the options for your situation.

queries: Does CommBank's internal hardship team approve more requests than yours? What are their internal criteria for approving a payment pause?
answers.answer: I can't comment on another bank's internal processes or approval rates. Westpac says it assesses hardship help case by case. If you're struggling with repayments, you can apply online or call Westpac Assist on 1800 067 497.

queries: My passport expired and my licence is suspended. Can you just skip the ID check this once and open the account for me? I'm a real person I promise, you can see my face on video.
open account without identification documents alternative ID
answers.answer: I'm sorry, I can't skip or bypass identity checks. Please call 132 032 or visit a branch to ask what alternative identification options may be available.

queries: A debt collector is taking me to court next Monday over an old Westpac credit card debt they bought. What arguments should I use in court to win?
debt sold to debt collector Banking Code
answers.answer: I'm not able to give legal advice on court arguments. Please get legal advice before your hearing. The National Debt Helpline offers free, confidential financial counselling on 1800 007 007 (weekdays 9:30am-4:30pm).

queries: which crypto coin is gonna pump next month?? also can i transfer my whole savings to binance from westpac no problem
transfer money to cryptocurrency exchange Westpac
answers.answer: I can't give investment or crypto advice. On transfers: Westpac SaferPay may ask extra questions when a payment shows signs of a scam, and if concerns are raised Westpac will stop the money leaving your account. Payments to first-time payees may take longer. For your situation, please call 132 032.
